tone.summary: A bright, compressed signal running through a clean Fender-style preamp (US Deluxe) with Chorus added for sheen, finished with a small Room reverb to give it space. The tone is optimized for jangly pop rhythm.

blocks.purpose: Clean up ambient noise and hum inherent in pop recording styles.
Even out the dynamics and add sustain necessary for tight pop rhythm playing.
Keep the tone clean and bright; no drive needed.
No wah effect required for this pop-rock style.
Simulate the bright, clean Fender-style tone associated with pop and country music.
Provide a bright and articulate sound suitable for jangly rhythm guitar.
Add the required light chorus sheen without making the tone wash out.
Slightly boost the high end and cut some low-mid mud for maximum clarity and jangle.
Provide a small amount of natural room ambience without sounding overly wet or distracting.
The verdict suggests dropping delay unless clearly audible; keeping it off for maximum tightness.
